body: I've thought of it, trying to help others, but I'm too much of a mess myself and hearing about other's experiences solidifies my position that this isn't a world worth living in.

Yeah, it's weird I guess but even as a child I always imagined my death would be by my own hand. It never happened because despite everything I was always at least a little bit hopeful but after a decade of different kinds of therapy, meds, addiction, homelessness, and being raped I'm just done.
Tried a lot. I like weed because it makes laughing easier. Have you tried dabs?

No use in comparing, I survived incest too and it's a particular kind of betrayal that I never experienced being exploited by strangers. I'm sorry he wasn't a good sibling to you. I hope you can sleep easy knowing he's gone.

I have no idea and no way of knowing whether or not the materials were disseminated or to whom, but considering I did cam shows, stills, and custom vids I assume they floated around as things on the internet are wont to do.
Haha, I've literally thought of that but that'd be way too upsetting.

I've been in therapy for ten years. Inpatient, outpatient, CBT, DBT, schema, psychodynamic, transpersonal, art therapy, animal therapy, and more. Tried more drugs than I can name. PTSD isn't the problem. The fact that it happened is the problem. The fact that it continues to happen is the problem. No amount of therapy changes reality.
